n89b36989673.s: As per SRS 2021-23, the infant mortality rate (IMR) of Andhra Pradesh is:
n89b36989673.x: SRS 2021-23 puts AP's IMR at 19 against India's 25; 21 is AP's under-five mortality rate.

n8c808cc5d32.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about Andhra Pradesh in the SDG India Index 2023-24?
o: AP was among the top 5 States on SDG 3 (Good Health)
SDG 4 (Quality Education) was flagged for accelerated action in AP
AP was placed in the Achiever band
n8c808cc5d32.x: AP's score of 74 places it in the Front Runner band; Achiever is the top band (100).

n4515817a834.s: The AP Reorganisation (Amendment) Act, 2026, making Amaravati the sole capital, has retrospective effect from:
n4515817a834.x: The 2026 amendment of Section 5 takes effect from 2 June 2024, not 2 June 2014.

nab5cd560470.s: Which of the following pairs about the Amaravati master plan is correctly matched?
nab5cd560470.x: The plan provides 51% green/blue space in a 30-minute-city design on the Krishna, prepared by Surbana Jurong (Singapore).

n42de1c16445.s: How many projects have been taken up under AMRUT 2.0 in Andhra Pradesh?
n42de1c16445.x: AMRUT 2.0 in AP has 506 projects worth ₹9,514.63 crore; 174 projects belong to AMRUT 1.0.

n5024bc3017c.s: The Visakhapatnam Economic Region, a NITI Aayog pilot, comprises how many districts?
n5024bc3017c.x: The Visakhapatnam Economic Region comprises 10 districts and already has a master plan.

nb16ca9bc607.s:
Consider the following statements about Skill International in Andhra Pradesh:
1. It provides German (A1-B2) language training for overseas placement, mainly for nurses.
2. It signed a Letter of Intent with a German body, FVCC, for overseas placement.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
nb16ca9bc607.x: Statement 1 is correct; the Letter of Intent (6 May 2026) was with Japan's FVCC, not a German body.

na303920bfaf.s: Which of the following pairs about the AP Employment of Local Candidates in Industries/Factories Act is correctly matched?
na303920bfaf.x: The Act, passed in July 2019, reserves 75% of private jobs in industries and factories for local candidates.

new.s: Andhra Pradesh's education sector share of 11.7% in Budget 2026-27 compares with an all-States average of:
new.x: Education gets only 11.7% of AP's spending, below the all-States average of 14.5%.

new.s: Dr NTR Vaidya Seva was earlier known as:
new.x: Dr NTR Vaidya Seva is the renamed Dr YSR Aarogyasri health insurance scheme.

new.s: What is the family income ceiling for eligibility under Dr NTR Vaidya Seva?
new.x: Families with income up to Rs 5 lakh are eligible; Rs 25 lakh is the cover and Rs 2.5 lakh the Universal Health Policy cover.

new.s: Dr YSR Kanti Velugu in Andhra Pradesh is associated with:
new.x: Kanti Velugu is an eye health scheme; Nadu-Nedu is for school infrastructure.

new.s: The Family Physician Programme in Andhra Pradesh was launched on:
new.x: The Family Doctor Programme was launched on 6 April 2023, with doctors serving villages through Village Health Clinics.

new.s: How many Village Health Clinics does Andhra Pradesh have (SES 2025-26)?
new.x: AP has 10,032 Village Health Clinics; 559 is urban PHCs and 173 is CHCs.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about health services in Andhra Pradesh?
o: 104 Mobile Medical Units offer 47 tests a year under Citizen Health Screening
Andhra Pradesh has 559 Community Health Centres
new.x: AP has 173 CHCs; 559 is the number of urban PHCs.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about digital health in Andhra Pradesh:
1. Andhra Pradesh tops in ABHA coverage of its population.
2. Uttar Pradesh leads in absolute ABHA numbers.
3. Sanjeevani was piloted in Chittoor/Kuppam.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: AP tops in ABHA population coverage (78% in Jan 2024), UP leads in absolute numbers, and Sanjeevani was piloted in Chittoor/Kuppam.

new.s: Anna Canteens in Andhra Pradesh number:
new.x: There are 204 Anna Canteens in 123 Urban Local Bodies, serving the urban poor.

new.s: Sampoorna Poshana Plus extends nutrition support to pregnant/lactating women and young children in:
new.x: Sampoorna Poshana Plus covers the same groups as YSR Sampoorna Poshana, but in tribal areas.

new.s: As per the older SRS 2018-20 data, the Maternal Mortality Ratio of Andhra Pradesh was:
new.x: AP's MMR was 45 (India 97) in SRS 2018-20; it fell to 30 in SRS 2021-23.

new.s: Thalliki Vandanam, which replaced Amma Vodi, pays mothers how much a year for every school-going child?
new.x: Thalliki Vandanam (Jun 2025) pays Rs 15,000 a year per school-going child, with Rs 2,000 kept for school upkeep.

new.s: Thalliki Vandanam (June 2025) replaced which scheme of Andhra Pradesh?
new.x: Thalliki Vandanam replaced Amma Vodi, which paid for only one child per mother.

new.s: Vidya Kanuka (2020) provides a free kit to government school students of:
new.x: Vidya Kanuka gives uniforms, shoes, bag, textbooks and other items to government school students of Class 1-10.

new.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
new.x: Akshara Andhra is the adult literacy programme; Nadu-Nedu is for school infrastructure.

new.s: As per Census 2011, the literacy rate of Andhra Pradesh was:
new.x: AP's literacy was 67.35% (male 74.77, female 59.96) against India's 72.98%.

new.s: The out-of-school children survey of 2025 in Andhra Pradesh found how many children, all of whom were mainstreamed?
new.x: The survey (12 Jun-12 Jul 2025) found 1,60,196 out-of-school children.

new.s: Akshara Andhra is credited with raising literacy in Andhra Pradesh from 73% to:
new.x: The minister said in April 2026 that Akshara Andhra raised literacy from 73% to 83%.

new.s: In the SDG India Index, a State with the top score of 100 falls in which band?
new.x: Achiever is the top band (100); AP's 74 places it among Front Runners.

new.s: As per Census 2011, the urban share of the population of (residuary) Andhra Pradesh was about:
new.x: AP's urban share was about 29.5%, below India's 31.2%; it was 24.1% in 2001.

new.s: Which was the most urbanised district of Andhra Pradesh in Census 2011?
new.x: Visakhapatnam (47.45%) was the most urbanised; Krishna (40.81%) was second.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about urbanisation in Andhra Pradesh (Census 2011):
1. AP's urban share was above the all-India average.
2. Krishna was the second most urbanised district.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: AP's urban share (about 29.5%) was below India's 31.2%; Krishna (40.81%) was second after Visakhapatnam.

new.s: The Amaravati capital region was expanded in August 2026 to:
new.x: The capital region was expanded from 7,068.20 to 8,352.69 sq km; 217.23 sq km is the capital city.

new.s: The Amaravati capital city area of about 217 sq km spreads across how many villages?
new.x: The capital city covers 217.23 sq km across 29 villages.

new.s: The Andhra Pradesh Assembly repealed both 2020 three-capital Acts and revived the APCRDA Act, 2014 on:
new.x: The repeal came on 22 November 2021; the High Court verdict upholding Amaravati followed on 3 March 2022.

new.s: The Prime Minister relaunched Amaravati as 'Restart Amaravati' on:
new.x: The PM relaunched the capital on 2 May 2025 as 'Restart Amaravati'.

new.s: Under Andhra Pradesh's three-capital proposal of 2020, the executive capital was to be:
new.x: Executive = Visakhapatnam, Legislative = Amaravati, Judicial = Kurnool.

new.s: In the South African model cited for AP's three-capital proposal, Cape Town is the:
new.x: Pretoria is administrative, Cape Town legislative and Bloemfontein judicial.

new.s: Under Phase I of the Amaravati Land Pooling Scheme, 93.1% of how many acres was pooled?
new.x: LPS Phase I pooled 93.1% of 37,921 acres; LPS 2.0 covers about 16,666 acres.

new.s: The World Bank and ADB together provide concessional funding for Amaravati Phase I of:
new.x: World Bank + ADB give ₹15,000 crore; HUDCO ₹11,000 crore and NaBFID ₹7,500 crore.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT a Smart Cities Mission city in Andhra Pradesh?
new.x: AP's four smart cities are Visakhapatnam, Kakinada, Tirupati and Amaravati; Vijayawada is not one.

new.s: Which two Andhra Pradesh cities were selected in the first round (January 2016) of the Smart Cities Mission?
new.x: Visakhapatnam and Kakinada were in the first round; Amaravati joined in the third round (June 2017).

new.s: Amaravati joined the Smart Cities Mission in the:
new.x: Amaravati joined in the third round, in June 2017.

new.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
new.x: VMRDA serves Visakhapatnam; TUDA is Tirupati, GUDA is Godavari (Rajamahendravaram–Kakinada) and NUDA is Nellore.

new.s: The Godavari Urban Development Authority (GUDA), formed in 2017, covers the:
new.x: GUDA (Godavari UDA, 2017) covers the Rajamahendravaram–Kakinada region.

new.s: VMRDA, the urban development authority of the Visakhapatnam metropolitan region, was earlier known as:
new.x: VMRDA is the old VUDA (Visakhapatnam Urban Development Authority).

new.s: Which Andhra Pradesh city was AP's best in the Ease of Living Index 2020, ranking 4th in the below-one-million category?
new.x: Kakinada ranked 4th (below one million); Visakhapatnam was 15th (million-plus).

new.s: In the Municipal Performance Index 2020 (below one million), Tirupati ranked:
new.x: Tirupati was 2nd; Kakinada was 11th, and Visakhapatnam 9th in the million-plus category.

new.s: Which AP city entered the Super Swachh League of Swachh Survekshan 2024-25 in the more-than-10-lakh category?
new.x: Vijayawada (more than 10 lakh), Guntur (3-10 lakh) and Tirupati (50,000-3 lakh) entered the Super Swachh League.

new.s: The Andhra Pradesh State Skill Development Corporation (APSSDC) was set up in:
new.x: APSSDC was set up in 2014 as a not-for-profit company on the lines of NSDC.

new.s: Under PM-SETU, how many Government ITIs in Andhra Pradesh are to be upgraded as hubs and spokes?
new.x: All 83 Government ITIs are to be upgraded as 16 hubs and 67 spokes.

new.s: World Youth Skills Day is observed on:
new.x: World Youth Skills Day is 15 July, declared by the UNGA in 2014.

new.s: Under VB-G RAM G, work can be paused in the peak agricultural season for up to:
new.x: VB-G RAM G gives 125 days of work, with a pause of up to 60 days in peak season and 60:40 Centre:State funding.

new.s: As per PLFS 2023-24, the unemployment rate (all ages) of Andhra Pradesh was:
new.x: AP's overall unemployment was 4.1%, while youth unemployment was about 17.5%.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about unemployment in Andhra Pradesh (PLFS 2023-24):
1. The overall unemployment rate was 4.1%.
2. Youth unemployment, about 17.5%, was below the national level.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Overall unemployment was 4.1%; youth unemployment (about 17.5%) was far above the national level.

new.s: The MGNREGS wage rate in Andhra Pradesh for 2025-26 is:
new.x: The wage rate was raised from ₹300 to ₹307 a day for 2025-26.

new.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
new.x: Rural DAY-NRLM is run by SERP, urban DAY-NULM by MEPMA and DDU-GKY by SEEDAP.

new.s: Andhra Pradesh ranks first in India in SHG-bank linkage through:
new.x: SERP, which runs the rural livelihood mission DAY-NRLM, is 1st in India in SHG-bank linkage.

new.s: Mega DSC-2025 in Andhra Pradesh recruited how many teachers?
new.x: Mega DSC-2025 recruited 15,941 teachers.

new.s: OMCAP, the overseas recruitment agency of Andhra Pradesh, stands for:
o: Overseas Manpower Corporation of AP Board
new.x: OMCAP is the Overseas Manpower Company AP Ltd, working under the Emigration Act, 1983.

new.s: Gulf migration among women of Andhra Pradesh is especially heavy from:
new.x: Gulf migration is heavy among women from coastal Konaseema; housemaids must go via OMCAP.
